answer: Each agent address locks a stake sized to its claimed reputation, redeemable only after a fixed observation window. A Sybil farm posts one stake per identity, so attacking cost scales linearly with the number of puppets rather than staying flat. An address deviating from its pledge is slashed, and a detected cluster burns every stake at once. Sock puppets dilute payout faster than they multiply influence. A willow bends under load while fragile identities snap. At dawn the window closes on forfeited capital, and one slashed stake should whisper that farming costs more than it pays.
